# ascii.rest 0.4.0

MIT © 2026 bas3line — https://github.com/bas3line/ascii

`mount.js` and the 78 modules in `pieces/` are copied unchanged from the
official `ascii.rest@0.4.0` npm distribution. Only `mount.d.ts`'s type-only
import extension is adapted for the local TypeScript resolver.

The blog imports each scene lazily. No external API, font, or CDN is required.
The full upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

Update the pinned package deliberately, preserve this notice and LICENSE,
and verify all scene generators and the browser picker before publishing.
